## AI-SDLC Verification Checklist
- [ ] **Tests Added / Passing**: All unit and integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] **Minimal Diff**: Edits are focused strictly on the scope of the feature/fix.
- [ ] **Edge Cases Handled**: Handled nulls, empty inputs, network timeouts, and errors.
- [ ] **Security Audit**: No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or unescaped inputs.
- [ ] **Living Memory**: Updated `ai-sdlc/memory/project-context.md` if architectural or stack changes occurred.
